items.question: Can PriceLeap push prices back to Amazon automatically?
items.shortAnswer: Yes. On Growth and Enterprise plans, PriceLeap can push approved price changes directly to Amazon Seller Central via the SP-API.
items.categoryDescription: Connecting PriceLeap to your existing tools and channels.

items.question: Does PriceLeap integrate with ERP systems?
items.shortAnswer: Enterprise plans support custom ERP and OMS integrations. Common integrations include NetSuite, SAP, and custom REST connections.
items.categoryDescription: Connecting PriceLeap to your existing tools and channels.

items.question: Does PriceLeap integrate with Shopify?
items.shortAnswer: Yes. PriceLeap integrates directly with Shopify to sync price updates back to your storefront in real time.
items.categoryDescription: Connecting PriceLeap to your existing tools and channels.

categories.label: Platform & Features
categories.desc: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

items.question: Is pricing automated or does my team review decisions?
items.shortAnswer: Both modes are available. You control how much autonomy the system has — per rule, per category, or per SKU.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

items.question: How many SKUs can PriceLeap handle?
items.shortAnswer: Starter covers up to 1,000 SKUs. Growth covers up to 10,000. Enterprise handles 50,000–100,000+ SKUs without performance loss.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

items.question: What marketplaces does PriceLeap cover?
items.shortAnswer: Amazon, Walmart, and eBay are covered natively. Additional marketplaces are available on Growth and Enterprise plans.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

items.question: How is PriceLeap different from price monitoring tools?
items.shortAnswer: Price monitoring tools show you data. PriceLeap converts that data into specific pricing decisions using rule-based logic with built-in margin protection.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

items.question: What is PriceLeap?
items.shortAnswer: PriceLeap is a pricing infrastructure engine that combines real-time competitor monitoring, rule-based decision logic, and margin protection into one system.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap's pricing intelligence engine works.

categories.label: Pricing & Plans
categories.desc: Plan details, billing, and what's included at each tier.

items.question: Can I cancel or change plans at any time?
items.shortAnswer: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades and cancellations apply at your next billing cycle.
items.categoryDescription: Plan details, billing, and what's included at each tier.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.shortAnswer: Yes — all plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required and access to the full feature set.
items.categoryDescription: Plan details, billing, and what's included at each tier.

items.question: How much does PriceLeap cost?
items.shortAnswer: Plans start at $299/month (Starter), $799/month (Growth), and custom pricing for Enterprise. All billed annually with a 14-day free trial.
items.categoryDescription: Plan details, billing, and what's included at each tier.

items.question: Are there setup fees or hidden costs?
items.shortAnswer: No. There are no setup fees on any plan. Onboarding is included, and there are no per-seat, per-SKU overage, or hidden charges.
items.categoryDescription: Plan details, billing, and what's included at each tier.

categories.label: Onboarding & Setup
categories.desc: Getting up and running with PriceLeap quickly.

items.question: How do I connect my catalog?
items.shortAnswer: Via CSV upload or REST API. Marketplace sellers can also connect directly through Amazon Seller Central and Walmart Seller Center integration.
items.categoryDescription: Getting up and running with PriceLeap quickly.

items.question: Do I need technical resources to set up PriceLeap?
items.shortAnswer: No. PriceLeap is a fully no-code platform. API access is available but never required for standard use.
items.categoryDescription: Getting up and running with PriceLeap quickly.

items.question: How long does it take to get started?
items.shortAnswer: Most teams are live within 48–72 hours. Catalog import, SKU matching, and first rules can all be completed in the first session.
items.categoryDescription: Getting up and running with PriceLeap quickly.

categories.label: Data & Security
categories.desc: How PriceLeap handles your pricing data and security.

items.question: How does PriceLeap collect competitor pricing data?
items.shortAnswer: PriceLeap collects competitor data through proprietary monitoring technology across Amazon, Walmart, and eBay, refreshed continuously.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap handles your pricing data and security.

items.question: Is my pricing data secure?
items.shortAnswer: Yes. PriceLeap is SOC 2 Type II compliant. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Your data is never shared with other customers.
items.categoryDescription: How PriceLeap handles your pricing data and security.
